root_cause.text: The `__construct_region()` function fails to free the allocated `res` resource structure when the first `sysfs_update_group()` call fails, leaking the memory because the resource has not yet been registered with the device lifecycle to be automatically cleaned up by `cxl_region_iomem_release()`.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff adds `kfree(res)` to the error path of `sysfs_update_group()` in `drivers/cxl/core/region.c`, and the commit message states that "Failing the first sysfs_update_group() needs to explicitly kfree the resource as it is too early for cxl_region_iomem_release() to do so."
